annotations.title: Public transport access by mesh block (by suburb)

description:
Distance to the nearest stop and station, share of homes within a short walk, and weekday service within 400 m, for every residential mesh block in Victoria, South East Queensland, Perth, Adelaide, Tasmania and Darwin.

Coverage: Victoria (trains, trams, buses, coaches), South East Queensland, the Perth region and the towns its bus network serves, Adelaide and its regional services, Tasmania, and Darwin. Not covered: New South Wales, the ACT, the rest of Queensland and the Northern Territory outside Darwin. A block is included when its suburb is included, i.e. when it is in a covered state and within 25 km of a stop; inside that area a suburb with no service shows real zeros. Current to 2026-11-06. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/public-transport-block`.

One call returns every mesh block in the suburb.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.
